title: Experiencia prematrimonial
writer: José Luis Martín Descalzo, Pedro Masó, Víctor Ruiz Iriarte
actors: Ornella Muti, Alessio Orano, Alberto Closas
plot: In Spain of 1972 a student couple decides to test the marriage before marrying in reality in order to prevent a irremediable failure. But this was like a revolution for the catholic society of this time.
